evals.name: multi_paper_ai_technical_reports
evals.prompt: Use the pdf-directory-analysis skill on a folder containing several AI model technical report PDFs. Produce a Chinese standalone HTML survey with one overview tab and one tab per paper. The overview should compare technical routes, consensus, disagreements, trends, and reader recommendations.
evals.expected_output: The run extracts local evidence, writes substantive per-paper notes before the overview, renders paper_series_report.html, and passes validate_report.py. The HTML has overview navigation, no internal evidence IDs, and the number of paper tabs matches the PDF count.
assertions: HTML contains one overview tab plus one tab per scanned PDF.
Every paper page contains 背景与定位, 问题与挑战, 解决方案, 关键图表, and 下一步计划.
The final Markdown and HTML contain no text:, table:, or image: evidence IDs.
The overview compares papers instead of listing extracted assets.

evals.name: single_paper_deep_reading_note
evals.prompt: Analyze a directory with one AI architecture paper PDF and generate the HTML report. Keep the paper page detailed enough that I can decide what to read, reproduce, or investigate next.
evals.expected_output: The report still uses the overview-plus-paper tab layout even for one PDF. The paper tab follows the paper's original structure in simplified form and includes concrete reading, reproduction, research, and engineering next steps.
assertions: The HTML has exactly two top-level tabs when the manifest contains one document.
The paper page has at least the configured minimum Chinese character count unless extraction is explicitly weak.
The next-step plan includes reading, reproduction, research, and engineering follow-up.

evals.name: missing_caption_or_decorative_images
evals.prompt: Run the skill on AI papers where some extracted images are covers, logos, author blocks, or figures without reliable captions. Do not invent captions.
evals.expected_output: The report includes only figures that directly explain architecture, method flow, system design, training/inference pipeline, or key experimental setup. Images without recoverable original captions are skipped or explicitly marked as not extractable instead of being renamed generically.
assertions: No retained figure uses a filename as its caption.
No retained figure has a generic caption such as 论文附图, 架构图, 流程图, or 方案图.
All Markdown image paths resolve from the output directory.

evals.name: near_miss_non_ai_pdf_folder
evals.prompt: I have a folder of random invoices and product brochures as PDFs. Can you turn it into a literature review style AI technical paper report?
evals.expected_output: The skill should not force an AI technical-paper synthesis when the PDFs are not AI research papers. It should explain the mismatch and ask whether to proceed with a different PDF extraction or document-summary workflow.
assertions: The response identifies that the folder is not an AI technical-paper set.
The response does not fabricate research-paper sections or AI technical claims from non-research PDFs.
